# Founder Witness Card Template (TBF-1)

A witness card is INVALID unless `tools/policy/validate_witness_readiness.py` has derived
`READY_FOR_HUMAN_PERCEPTION_WITNESS` for the exact candidate SHA. The card must state:
- what machine verification already proved (so the founder does not repeat it);
- exactly what human judgment is being asked for (perception, usability, signature, authority,
  live-action) — nothing machine-testable;
- the candidate SHA + evidence manifest path + checker/Advisor verdicts;
- remaining limitations explicitly allowed by the witness contract.
